Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 14, the Planner incorrectly inferred that the death city was "La Plata" (Buenos Aires Province, Argentina) based on the fact that Buenos Aires is the capital of the province. This is a geographical error; Buenos Aires is a specific city and the federal capital, not a province (though it is also a province, the city is distinct). The Planner explicitly decided to change the target city from Buenos Aires to La Plata without any source evidence supporting La Plata as the death location. All sources consistently pointed to Buenos Aires. This hallucination led to an incorrect conclusion about the specific city of death.
